dce1b1cf.text: As the politics and rivalries of the seven human nations waxed and waned, the line of Guardians kept its constant vigil against chaos. There were many Guardians over the years, but only one ever held the magical powers of Tirisfal at any given time. One of the last Guardians of the age distinguished herself as a mighty warrior against the shadow.
dce1b1cf.title: Aegwynn and the Dragon Hunt

10267|5b83aa12.name: Tinkee Steamboil
10267|5b83aa12.text: The Burning Steppes is a dangerous place, but scholars like me will do almost anything to advance our knowledge.

10307|ddeae011.name: Witch Doctor Mau'ari
10307|ddeae011.text: Ah, $r... I possess great knowledge a' da world and how ta create charms a' great power.

10431|9b95be26.name: Gregor Greystone
10431|9b95be26.text: Greetings, my friend.  May the Dawn keep you well in these troubled times.

11118|60c5da07.name: Innkeeper Vizzie
11118|60c5da07.text: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.

11139|c5ceacbe.name: Yugrek
11139|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

11191|e6a3a2b1.name: Lilith the Lithe
11191|e6a3a2b1.text: Don't get too close, $N. I'm liable to fumble and bash your brains open with the face of my hammer.

11556|21e024ed.name: Salfa
11556|21e024ed.text:
The Winterfall furbolg that reside here in Winterspring were once our allies... But one day, that all changed.

Driven by the strange demands of their high chief, they began to attack all others that they came in contact with, including our tribe. They keep to themselves now...

11556|ffa625d1.name: Salfa
11556|ffa625d1.text: We Timbermaw can grant you safe passage through the hold, however, you must prove yourself worthy of our aid.

11900|c5ceacbe.name: Brakkar
11900|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

11956|cbd3ea7f.name: Great Bear Spirit
11956|cbd3ea7f.text: The bear looks at you calmy and patiently, but says nothing.

12137|c087faab.name: Squibby Overspeck
12137|c087faab.text: Slip a little coin into the boss's hand and look what it gets ya. I love my job. Though, if I could find a way to get that little firecracker Snurk reassigned to this port....well, I can't imagine it any better. But I'm betting that you aren't here about my business practices. You're looking for the Zeppelin to Undercity, am I right? Well that's great, because it docks right here behind me. Oh and hey, if you see Snurk, put a good word in for me, would ya?

12740|c5ceacbe.name: Faustron
12740|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

14742|39230d1f.name: Zap Farflinger
14742|39230d1f.text: I have just completed a new dimensional imploder that will make me rich beyond my wildest goblin dreams!   All I need to do is get a skilled Goblin Engineer to build a dimensional ripper that connects to it and try it!

14743|d6c927df.name: Jhordy Lapforge
14743|d6c927df.text: With some of the technology that was recovered by bold gnomes venturing into Gnomeregan, I have managed to construct my greatest invention:  The Matter Transporter!    All I need now is a skilled Gnomish Engineer to build a powerful beacon attuned to the transporter.

228216|5fae50d6.name: Nami
228216|5fae50d6.text: <Nami is preoccupied, adjusting the viewfinder of the gigantic telescope.>

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

5411|7162d6b1.name: Krinkle Goodsteel
5411|7162d6b1.text: Welcome to Tanaris, $N. How can I be of service to you today? You don't look like a blacksmith to me, but I know how looks can be deceiving.

7733|606adfaa.name: Innkeeper Fizzgrimble
7733|606adfaa.text: Ah a visitor! Must be an adventurer, we don't get many tourists down this way. Grab a chair and a drink, make yourself comfortable. Say, you look like you have some meat on your bones. You thinkin about competing in the cage matches?

7763|d059fc6f.name: Curgle Cranklehop
7763|d059fc6f.text:
Hi there! I have a proposition for an adventure-seeker such as you, if you are up to the challenge!

Along with my invention, the Super Egg-O-Matic, I am hard at work aiding the druids with their campaign to save the hippogryphs. The birds are being affected by the evil effects of the Gordunni ogres inhabiting the ruins of Feralas, and their numbers are dwindling.

I collect many different types of eggs.  Will you help and find some for me?

9563|289dd4d8.name: Ragged John
9563|289dd4d8.text: Me versus fifty orcs? I'm no fool, $N. My pappy always told me, 'Discreditin is the better part of a cracker,' or something, and I knew what that meant.

9563|884cd640.name: Ragged John
9563|884cd640.text:
Windsor was particularly ornery that day - and believe me, for Windsor, that's a monumental accomplishment. He kept telling me that 'something feels off.' Well he wasn't kidding!

We were in the middle of Blackrock Mountain when the filthy animals attacked. I'm talking about the orcs, of course. Pay attention, will ya? All you could hear were grunts and the clanging of steel as they rushed us.

9563|af7a4527.name: Ragged John
9563|af7a4527.text:
Alright, alright. Anyhow, so I sorta slipped into the shadows.

That didn't sit too well with Windsor, seeing as how he was already extra cranky. Well he started spinnin' old Ironfoe around and screaming like a mad man at the orcs.

9563|b705eb63.name: Ragged John
9563|b705eb63.text:
Aright *hic*... Say, you look familiar *hic*. Have I ever told you about the time me and Windsor fought off thir, er... a thous... a million orcs?

Oh settle down friend, this is a good one!
